user.title: Connect to AWS Bedrock
user.description: Enter your AWS credentials. The IAM user or role must have `bedrock:InvokeModel` and `bedrock:ListFoundationModels` permissions. [Learn more]({docs_url})

data_description.aws_access_key_id: Your AWS IAM access key ID
data_description.aws_secret_access_key: Your AWS IAM secret access key
data_description.aws_region: The AWS region where Bedrock models are deployed

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate AWS Bedrock
reauth_confirm.description: Your AWS credentials need to be updated.

error.invalid_credentials: Invalid AWS credentials. Please check your Access Key ID and Secret Access Key.
error.access_denied: Access denied. Ensure your IAM user/role has `bedrock:ListFoundationModels` and `bedrock:InvokeModel` permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to AWS Bedrock. Check your network and region.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Please check the logs.

abort.already_configured: An AWS Bedrock integration with these credentials already exists.

data_description.prompt: Override the default system prompt. Leave blank to use the default.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Enable Home Assistant control tools (allows the AI to turn on lights, read sensors, etc.)
data_description.recommended: Use recommended model and settings. Disable to customize the model and parameters.

data_description.chat_model: The Bedrock model to use. Choose a model that is enabled in your AWS account.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Cannot add a conversation agent while the integration is not loaded.

run_audit.name: Run setup audit
run_audit.description: Analyses all entities and devices using an AWS Bedrock model and posts a report as a persistent notification with recommendations to delete stale entities, rename poorly named ones, and fix potential issues.
